column3: Superconductivity, magnetism, quantum transport, ultracold atoms in optical lattices and strongly correlated systems.
How structural changes govern the dynamics of materials, from ionic crystals and magnets to clays and biological systems.
Theoretical condensed matter: quantum transport and quantum information devices, topological superconductors, superconductor-semiconductor hybrids and Majorana states; directs QDev.
Keywords: molecular electronics, statistical physics, superconductivity, magnetism, electron transport.
Electron microscopy of crystalline materials, including in-situ studies and semiconductor nanowires.
Soft-matter physics: self-assembly studied with small-angle X-ray and neutron scattering.
Magnetism and superconductivity studied by neutron scattering: quantum magnetism, quantum phase transitions and instrumentation for ESS.
Quantum coherent electronics and qubit implementations, topological states of matter and quantum computing.
Solid-state and nanophysics for quantum technology: nanowires, quantum transport, nanofabrication and low-temperature physics.
Quantum many-body theory of solid-state systems: strongly correlated electron transport through quantum dots and molecules, superconductors and magnets.
Parallel numerical algorithms for scientific computing, including large block-tridiagonal matrices in quantum physics.
Keywords: quantum technology, semiconductor nanowires, superconducting hybrids.
